notes: PLATFORM CORRECTION: this is NOT the Cornerstone Brands platform described in my assignment. thecompanystore.com runs Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Sites-TCS-Site), confirmed by robots.txt and by the /on/demandware.store/Sites-TCS-Site/... controller paths embedded in every listing page. No JSONAPIs, UnbxdAPI, CBI-AJAX or SiteMap_CAT_00N_v2.xml endpoints exist here, so the Cornerstone recipe was not used; the SFCC method from the prior Home-Decor pass on this same company was used instead. ACCESS: plain direct fetch, HTTP 200, no bot protection, no proxy needed. robots.txt names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent. TREE: taken from the rendered mega-menu (.main-menu) on the homepage, cross-checked against sitemap_1.xml (5,670 URLs, 457 of them category URLs). The navigation contains exactly two furniture departments: Home Decor > Furniture (/furniture, cgid man-decor-hd-type-furniture, header '101 Results') and Outdoor > Outdoor Furniture (/outdoor-furniture, cgid man-outdoor-type-outdoor-furniture, header '9 Results'). LEAVES: each department's own product-type navigation (prefn1=variousTypes, the same URL shape the prior Home-Decor pass used and validated on this site) is its child level. Furniture splits into Headboards 71 + Benches 15 + Ottomans & Footstools 15 = 101, exactly the parent total. Outdoor Furniture splits into Adirondack Chairs 3 + Arm Chairs 1 + Benches 1 + Ottomans & Footstools 1 + Accent Tables 2 + Poufs 1 = 9, exactly the parent total. Both parents are therefore fully decomposed and are NOT emitted as leaves. QTY METHOD: the rendered listing header 'N Results' on each facet URL, then independently verified by enumerating the site's own Search-UpdateGrid controller (cgid + sz=300) and counting product tiles - the header and the enumerated tile count matched on all 9 leaves and on both parents. Every count was read three times with zero drift. One tile = one colourway on this platform (the 101 Furniture tiles resolve to 11 distinct headboard styles plus the benches and ottomans); per instruction these were NOT deduplicated to unique part numbers. SANITY CHECKS: (a) counts vary per node (101/71/15/15/9/3/2/1) so no site-wide constant is being echoed; (b) the h1 of every page fetched matched the department expected, so no silent parent-serving; (c) the full /outdoor-furniture HTML page contains 11 product-tile class hits but the grid controller returns 9 - the extra 2 come from a recommendations carousel, so the carousel-overcount trap was avoided by counting only through the grid controller; (d) /nav-outdoor-type returned a constant 152 for every facet value (it ignores the facet and 301s to /outdoor-living) and was rejected as a counting source. ABSENCE PROVEN FOR EVERYTHING ELSE: a regex sweep of the sitemap for furnitur|sofa|couch|sectional|chair|stool|bench|table|desk|bed|headboard|nightstand|dresser|wardrobe|armoire|cabinet|bookcase|shelv|seating|ottoman|pouf|daybed|chaise|recliner|crib|vanity|console|sideboard|loveseat|dining returned only /furniture, /outdoor-furniture and /featured-outdoor-furniture-and-decor (a mixed featured landing page of 184 items, excluded per section 3). Site search was first discrimination-tested before being trusted: snowmobile=0, nightstand=0, bookcase=0, wardrobe=0, sectional=0, armoire=0, sideboard=0, cabinet=0, shelf=0 versus 'duvet cover'=121, so it does discriminate. Every non-zero furniture-word query turned out to be a spell-correction artefact, confirmed by the response's own suggestedSearchText field: sofa -> 'soft' (bath rugs and pillows), desk -> 'dusk' (sateen sheets), dresser -> 'dresses' (caftans), 'dining table' -> 'table' (tablecloths and runners); daybed and 'bed frame' return bed sheets only. 'bench' returns 5 (the 3 indoor storage benches, the outdoor Garden Bench, 1 bench cushion), 'chair' returns 11 (the 4 outdoor chairs, the rest chair cushions), 'vanity' returns 5 vanity TRAYS (bath accessories, not furniture), 'stool' returns a mattress pad and a pillow protector. The retailer therefore sells no sofas, beds or bed frames, desks, dressers, wardrobes, cabinets, bookcases, dining tables or nightstands - every furniture product in the catalogue is captured by the 9 rows above. EXCLUDED: 'Chairs' and 'Accent Tables' pills/facets still exist in the indoor /furniture navigation but return 0 tiles (discontinued), so they were dropped rather than emitted as zero rows; the 3 accent tables the prior pass saw under /home-accents are gone (that facet now returns 0). Crib Mattresses and Mattresses excluded as bedding per section 1; crib sheets, crib skirts and changing pads are textiles, and the site sells no cribs or changing tables. Floor Mirrors and Wall Mirrors excluded (Wall Decor's job). All bedding, bath, loungewear, rugs, tabletop, wallpaper, botanicals and lighting excluded. Pet Beds & Covers excluded (pet goods). All Sale/Clearance/New Arrivals/Best Seller/collaboration and 'Featured' landing pages excluded per section 3. CATEGORY BUCKETS: 'Outdoor Furniture' is used as its own top bucket because that is the site's own department name and section 7 explicitly sanctions it. Both trees are only two levels deep (department > product type), which maps directly onto the Category/Sub-Category columns, so no grouping rows are required.
